title: Web Bundle Budget And Product Pruning
problem: The Vite runtime is clean, but copied v0 domains and heavy dependencies still need explicit budget enforcement and product-scope pruning.
evidence: Activated after WALW-050 closeout commit ee6d5cdc; WBBP-020 is ready.
WBBP-020 added bundle budget instrumentation and `npm --prefix web run build:budget` passed within thresholds.
WBBP-030 removed v0-only deferred media domains from the live runtime graph; `npm --prefix web run check`, `npm --prefix web run test`, and `npm --prefix web run build:budget` passed.

continue_policy.notes: Run WBBP-040 to remove unused heavy dependencies and generated components left behind by pruning.
